verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a consumer chat platform, but the evidence shows no first-party way to operate Discord through natural-language commands. Slash commands are structured `/` invocations. The bot, Gateway and REST APIs are developer building blocks a third party could use to build such an agent, not the capability itself. The llms.txt and markdown docs only make the documentation readable by LLMs, not the product operable by them.
